sentences.japanese: 学生は各々順番に卒業証書を受け取った。
sentences.english: Each student received his diploma in turn.

sentences.japanese: 学生たちは各々その会合に出席しなければならない。
sentences.english: Each of the students has to attend the meeting.

sentences.japanese: 各々の乗客には荷物二つの制限がある。
sentences.english: There is a limit of two pieces of luggage for each passenger.

sentences.japanese: 各ロボットには通話機が取り付けられています。
sentences.english: Each robot is equipped with a talking machine.

sentences.japanese: ということはつまり、たとえ彼らが各々２子しか持たないとしても人口は急増し続けるだろう。
sentences.english: That means that even if they only have two children each, the population will continue to grow rapidly.
